data.note: opencode/kilo lane driver behind Lane contract

data.budget: 10 min, offline, no model, no key
data.claim: A mcp (opencode shape) and instructions entry in the lane-home global config is loaded, and `run` takes the task as a message plus --file, --format json, --model, --dir, --auto.
data.falsifier: `kilo debug config` on a scratch HOME omits the mcp or instructions entry, or `kilo run --help` lacks the flags.
data.mechanism: kilo is an opencode fork that merges the global config dir into its config; the descriptor says shape opencode.
data.probe: HOME=<scratch> kilo debug config; HOME=<scratch> kilo mcp list; kilo run --help
data.probe_output: debug config listed mcp.ddflow {type local, command [...], environment, enabled true} and instructions [A.md] with instruction_origins trusted; mcp list: 'ddflow connected, 1 server(s)'; run --help lists --format json, -m, --dir, --auto, -f/--file, --pure.
data.question: Does kilo 7.8.18 read a lane-private mcp entry and instructions list from $HOME/.config/kilo/kilo.json, and what flags take the task text headless?

evidence.note: research Rf3edbc2083 CONFIRMED: kilo debug config / mcp list / run --help read offline on a scratch HOME. Stream JSON shape NOT read (unverified).
